subject: Invoice pulse, entity-sweep & VAT evidence — playbook for annual prepay
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: treasury@helioshealth.io
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Marcus — thanks again for the overview this morning. We reviewed the commitment model with our finance team and they asked two quick things before we sign:  

1) Can Redwood invoice on a monthly 'pulse' (12 invoices) rather than a single upfront invoice? We prefer monthly cashflow but still want the committed discount.  
2) We operate out of two legal entities (US / UK). Can you provide a remit matrix so each invoice posts to the correct legal entity and VAT handling?

Attached our treasury remit contact. If you can send an example invoice flow and the VAT evidence you need from us, we can get procurement to sign faster.

— Sana
Head of Finance, Helios Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Sana — great questions. Summary below and next steps at the bottom. TL;DR: we can support a 12x monthly invoice rhythm while applying the annual committed discount, and we’ll provide an entity-sweep template for remit mapping + a VAT evidence checklist.

What we propose (high-level):
- Invoice rhythm: 12 monthly invoices (first month billed on contract effective date). Invoices will reflect the annual committed amount pro-rated into 12 equal pulses unless you opt for front-loaded tiers (we can model).
- Discounting: contracted committed discount is applied across the annual total; each pulse invoice will show the discounted per-month allocation and a line-item referencing the commitment id (HL-2025-0042).
- Entity sweep/remit: we’ll produce a remit matrix mapping SKU/accounting codes to your US and UK entities. For treasury, we can emit invoices from Redwood US (for USD remit) or Redwood EU (for GBP/EUR remit) depending on the entity mapping you provide.
- VAT evidence: for the UK entity we need: registered VAT number (copy), local invoice-to entity mapping, and any reverse-charge election docs if applicable. We accept a single consolidated VAT evidence package per quarter; otherwise we’ll request per-invoice evidence for tax holdbacks.

Operational guardrails we recommend:  
1) Pooling vs legal split: For commercial simplicity we can pool usage under the commitment (single consumption ledger) and sweep revenue into legal entities monthly. This preserves the committed discount and minimizes invoice churn.
2) Retention/chargebacks: Any disputed usage will be flagged within 15 days of invoice — disputes open a remediation window. Significant disputes (>10% of pulse) may trigger temporary holdbacks until resolved.

Next steps (action owners):
- Marcus: produce "entity-sweep remit matrix" template + sample monthly invoice (by EOD tomorrow).
- Kimberly: draft the VAT evidence checklist and list of acceptable docs (by Tue).
- Sana / Treasury: confirm preferred remit bank accounts per entity and upload entity registration docs (VAT copy + company reg).

I’ll attach sample templates and a quick workbook so procurement can confirm.

— Marcus
Director, Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Sana — looping in the VAT checklist and a short note on acceptable evidence. See attached checklist (VAT-Evidence-Checklist.docx). Key items:  
- UK VAT: company VAT registration certificate + matching invoice remit name and address. If reverse charge: purchaser confirmation letter.
- US: we do not collect US sales tax for services in most states but will accept exemption certificates where applicable.
- Invoices referencing entity ids: please provide the exact legal name, address and VAT/Tax id as you want it printed.

A practical approach that most customers use: provide a quarterly bundle (end of quarter) of VAT evidence and a one-page treasury remit table that we use to sweep revenue into your entities. If you can’t do quarterly bundles, we’ll require per-invoice evidence for the UK entity (might add processing lead time).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

— Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: treasury@helioshealth.io
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Thanks — this looks good. A couple clarifications before we send to procurement:  
- For the pooled-consumption + monthly sweep approach, can Redwood provide a monthly remittance file (CSV) with invoice -> entity mapping, GL codes and net/gross split so our ERP can auto-post?  
- Any P&L recognition quirks we should flag for the UK entity (e.g., when you issue monthly invoices but recognition is on the annual contract)? Our accounting team prefers clear invoice-level memo fields to reconcile.

We can prepare the entity list and VAT copies by Wed EOD. If you can send the sample invoice and remit CSV template, procurement will likely sign next week.

— Sana
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2025 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Sana — attaching the sample artifacts as requested (listed in attachments). Quick answers:  
- Yes, we will provide a machine-readable monthly remittance CSV that includes: invoice_number, invoice_date, entity_code, GL_account, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, commitment_id. That file will be uploaded to your shared SFTP / Drive link.
- Recognition: Redwood issues invoices monthly (cash basis) but we will include a contract memo line: "Annual commitment HL-2025-0042 — monthly pulse allocation — recognition per customer policy" to make ERP tagging straightforward. If you want us to emit a separate recognition-only report for your FP&A team, we can add that to the monthly bundle.

I’ll set up a short SFTP share and send access instructions; Kimberly will follow up on VAT docs.

— Marcus
From: treasury@helioshealth.io
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@helioshealth.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — prefer monthly pulse, entity split Qs

Marcus — received the templates, thanks. One last ask from treasury: can Redwood include the beneficiary / bank remittance name on each invoice in a consistent field (BANK_BENEFICIARY) so our bank reconciliation matches automatically? If yes we’ll confirm account numbers for both entities.

— Helios Treasury
